data.title: Follow-up on the renewal
data.body:
Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the call today. Here is what we agreed:

- **Pricing:** unchanged for the next two quarters
- **Seats:** 40, up from 25
- **Start date:** Monday, November 16

If anything looks off, [book a quick call](https://example.com/call) and we can sort it out.

Best,
Priya

data.title: Weekly product report
data.body:
## Highlights

The onboarding rewrite shipped to **all accounts** on Wednesday.

| Metric | Before | After |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Activation | 41% | 57% |
| Time to first card | 6m 12s | 2m 48s |
| Support tickets | 34 | 19 |

## Risks

> The import queue is still single-threaded. A backlog above 20 minutes would delay activation reporting.

## Next week

1. Move the import queue to workers
2. Add a progress indicator to the import screen
3. Retire the `legacy_import` flag

---

Questions to `#product-weekly`.
